BJP Accuses INDIA Bloc of Parliament Disruption

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has accused the INDIA bloc of deliberately disrupting parliamentary proceedings. The BJP specifically targeted Rahul Gandhi, alleging he is disrupting Parliament out of fear. These accusations come amidst ongoing disruptions within the Parliament.
